lead: Secure Your Skies with Pioneering Anti-Drone Systems

blocks.html: Keep your skies clear with our pioneering anti-drone systems that can efficiently detect and intercept any unwanted drones and unmanned aerial vehicles, using advanced radio frequency and radar detection technologies.

They can powerfully detect low-flying, small UAVs that are difficult to identify through the naked eye, and block drone communication by blasting electromagnetic noise at the radio frequency, drowning any sensitive information, with a jamming range capability of up to two kilometers. And if needed, our advanced anti-drone systems can shoot a laser-based attack on the unwanted aerial vehicle to destroy it completely, within a range of up to one kilometer.
